/bin/bash -lc "sqlite3 -readonly -header -column assets/data/career_path.db <<'SQL'
WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id, slug, name, parent_id, depth, root_id) AS (
  SELECT id, slug, name, parent_id, 0, id FROM career_nodes
  WHERE id IN (67,68,70,71,72,73)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id, c.slug, c.name, c.parent_id, a.depth+1, a.root_id
  FROM career_nodes c JOIN ancestors a ON c.id=a.parent_id
), paths AS (
  SELECT root_id,
         group_concat(name, ' > ') AS breadcrumb
  FROM (SELECT root_id, name FROM ancestors ORDER BY root_id, depth DESC)
  GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT n.id, n.slug, n.name, p.breadcrumb
FROM career_nodes n JOIN paths p ON p.root_id=n.id
ORDER BY n.id;
SQL"
